name: Mushroom & Olive Stuffed Pizza Burgers with Lemon-Artichoke Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
0.23 kg cremini mushrooms
3 tomatoes
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to coat, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Mince olives and mushrooms; place both in another large bowl.
Add beef and spices to the bowl with the olives; mix with your hands until well to combined. Form into six, 1-inch thick patties, and place on a plate. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, cut tomatoes into thick slices and season both sides with salt and basil.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp basil, dried

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add tomatoes and grill until lightly charred, about 1 minute per side. Transfer to a plate.

Working in batches if necessary, place burger patties on the pan and grill, undisturbed, 5 minutes. Flip patties and top with cheese and grilled tomatoes; continue to grill until cooked through, 5 minutes more. Transfer to the plate used for the tomatoes.
Meanwhile, chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the artichokes and toss to combine the salad.
If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes. Work in batches if necessary.
Assemble pizza burgers and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy.
